messages:
Tasha (Support): Heads-up 1 Orion Analytics trial (tenant=orion-trial-9) is intermittently hitting embedding timeouts + 5xx during an initial dataset import. They're in week 2 of trial and have a scheduled exec demo in 48h. Escalating to CS for priority handling.
Owen (CS): Got it. Can you paste the failing request id / error payload and any correlation id? I'll start a comms draft and loop the AE.
Tasha (Support): request id: req_0a9c3f; error: "upstream_timeout"; snippet: ```POST /v1/embeddings 504 \n{"error":"upstream_timeout","detail":"worker unresponsive"}```
Tasha (Support): Customer report: "Upload hangs, then we get an error. This blocks our demo flow."
Maya (Infra): Investigating 1 seeing a pattern where small concurrent uploads cause a worker pool eviction due to OOM on a specific model variant. We're rolling a patch to pin the model variant and recycle the pool. ETA ~20m.
Priya (Account): I'm on the call list for the demo and marking renewal-risk. If this isn't resolved before the demo we'll need to offer a concession. Owen, what's the comms plan?
Owen (CS): Draft: 1) immediate transparent notice + expected ETA; 2) offer a 30-min remediation session before the exec demo; 3) post-demo follow-up + account health check. Will send now and CC AE.
Evan (Billing): If we need to offer a credit for downtime during the trial, we can approve up to a one-week trial extension; need a quick note in billing ticket.
Tasha (Support): Customer asked for a P0 escalation. They flagged the exec presence.
Maya (Infra): Patch applied to worker pool routing; we've pinned the model variant and increased worker memory limit for that tenant's pool. ops-bot: change_request CR-3345 created.
ops-bot: pool-restart triggered for orion-trial-9 (initiated by Maya).
Tasha (Support): Retest from the customer shows uploads completing but a couple of retries required. They say explorer load is back to normal.
Priya (Account): Thanks 1 Owen, please schedule the remediation/demo prep session for tomorrow morning. I'll update the AE and the execs.
Owen (CS): Booking 30-min remediation for tomorrow 9:30am ET. Message sent to customer: "We applied a targeted fix and are monitoring; we can run a quick walkthrough before your demo to confirm flow. Apologies for the interruption."
Evan (Billing): Opening billing ticket for potential extension/credit: BT-7892. Noting concession hold until post-demo review.
Maya (Infra): Adding follow-up action: run a targeted load test for onboarding imports and add a guardrail to prevent OOM on that model variant.
Tasha (Support): Passing to CS for continued ownership; support closing their handoff.
Priya (Account): Marked renewal-watch, capturing these notes: "trial import OOM -> transient 504s; infra mitigation applied; remediation session scheduled; billing concession on hold."
Owen (CS): I'll do a post-demo check-in and collect feedback on the import tooling. Also will suggest a safe-import script for onboarding to avoid bursts.
Maya (Infra): Will schedule a quick retro with eng infra + support to add the guardrail and monitoring alert.
Owen (CS): Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll update this thread after the remediation session and add next steps for churn mitigation.
